definitions.gloss: to be included, to come with
definitions.explanation: To be provided along with something.

examples.japanese: {服|ふく}にペンキが{付|つ}いた。
{毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}していたら、だんだん{力|ちから}が{付|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: By practicing every day, I gradually built up strength.

examples.japanese: このプランには{朝食|ちょうしょく}が{付|つ}いている。
{新|あたら}しいパソコンには{三|さん}{年|ねん}の{保証|ほしょう}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: The new computer comes with a three-year warranty.

notes:
{付|つ}く is an intransitive godan verb meaning something attaches or sticks by itself.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive): {付|つ}く - something attaches
- {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive): {付|つ}ける - to attach something

ASPECT (ている):
{付|つ}いている indicates a resulting state: "is attached/stuck."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {気|き}が{付|つ}く: to notice, become aware
- {身|み}に{付|つ}く: to acquire (a skill), to learn
- {運|うん}が{付|つ}く: to be lucky
- {嘘|うそ}が{付|つ}く: to lie (different kanji: {嘘|うそ}をつく)
- 〜{付|つ}き: with 〜 included ({朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き = with breakfast)
